name: plex-advisor
description: Unofficial MCP bridge for personal Plex library facts, ratings, history, and explicit local feedback. Not affiliated with Plex.

interface.longDescription: An unofficial MCP bridge connecting ChatGPT, Codex, and other MCP clients to your personal Plex library, ratings, and viewing history. The assistant handles conversation and recommendation judgment. Plex access is read-only. Qualitative feedback is saved locally only when explicitly requested. Plex Bridge is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Plex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show my recent Plex viewing history and personal ratings, including when the data was last synced.
